description:
`await_ready/2` exits instead of returning `{:error, _}`, against its `@spec`. A failed start loses its reason in 12-25% of runs: `:noproc` or `{:error, :worker_unavailable}` in place of `:not_found`, `:conflict`, or `:deleted`. Rerun thaw of 200: `:not_found` 153, `:noproc` 30, `:worker_unavailable` 17. Also a definite SQL error reports as `:indeterminate`.

Owner: `jido.agent_server.activation`
Root cause: `lib/jido/agent_server.ex:743-744`; `lib/jido/agent_server/supervisor.ex:118-126`
Claims: agent-servers.B2, agent-servers.B3, durability.B1, built-in-plugins.B1, composition.B4, storage.B3 (table part)
Repro (probe file: id prefix): `02_start_agent`: `N5`; `20_b_agent_servers`: `agent-servers.B2`; `20_b_durability`: `durability.B1`; `MIX_ENV=test 20_b_storage_ecto`: `storage.B3`
Guides: `guides/agent-servers/hibernate-thaw-and-activate.md`; `guides/durability/deletion-and-tombstones.md`; `guides/built-in-plugins/signal-bus-plugin.livemd:255`

Done when: await_ready/2 matches its @spec, and a failed start reports its real reason in every run of a repeated race test.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B09. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.

comments.text: Fixed in 443efef, b835ee4, 7ef33f8, 948f99f, a702dd8, 7506b49. Gaps: :plugin_start_failed and bootstrap timeouts record no reason; 1,024 slots can evict a reason and fall back to :noproc; a dead server addressed by name gives :noproc. Definite SQL errors cover missing table or column only, and Postgres was tested with a fake repo.

title: Make await_ready return errors and keep the failed-start reason
